sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The RB-ORB2 key (RB-ORB2) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to one of the Federal State Reserve Agency base southern barracks' armories.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - Required for the quest Reserve Expert from Ragman

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In the Common fund stash (Shturman's crate)
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Woods
sections.text: - Near the tank at the "RUAF Gate" extraction on a concrete wall piece that has a "HELP" inscription

sections.heading: Reserve
sections.text:
- Inside a locker which is located in a dressing room inside the connection tunnel from the radar station to the white pawn barracks

- In different locations in the main room on the second floor of the barracks marked with white pawn.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Eastern barracks area on Reserve. East end of the southern building (white pawn), 2nd floor. (Highlighted in green)

sections.heading: Behind the Lock
sections.text:
- Loose loot (Weapon mods, Ammunition)
- One Drawer
- One Weapon box (4x4)
- One Weapon box (6x2)
